## Scope
Deliver a full-stack, commercial-grade MVP for "Moment Diary" using Bun, Hono, React, and SQLite. The application will support user authentication, diary management (CRUD), timeline view, calendar view, and statistical insights.

## Tech Stack
- **Backend**: [Bun](https://bun.sh/) runtime, [Hono](https://hono.dev/) web framework.
- **Database**: [SQLite](https://www.sqlite.org/) (via `bun:sqlite`).
- **Frontend**: [React](https://react.dev/) + [Vite](https://vitejs.dev/) + [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/).
- **Styling**: [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/) + [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com/) for commercial-grade components.
- **Charts**: [Recharts](https://recharts.org/) for statistical visualizations.
- **Icons**: [Lucide React](https://lucide.dev/).
- **State Management**: React Context / Hooks for simple state, or `tanstack-query` for server state.
